_readme: Timing and actuator-model parameters for M3. Only what the firmware does
not already expose through the bridge lives here; the controller periods
(send interval, shoulder property read, feedback timeout, session length)
and every control value are read from the shared library via
sim/controller.py Controller.site, never copied into this file.
status: measured = from a document or a real statistic, estimated =
derived from a document, assumed = modelling assumption, unknown = no data.

step_s.source: same value as model/params.json meta.timestep_s; the firmware service period is 1 ms (s1_config.h S1_SERVICE_MS)

elbow_counts_per_rev.source: C620 feedback 0..8191 per revolution, s3_feedback.c uses 6.2831853/8192

elbow_quantize.source: the raw C620 tick is rounded to the nearest count; shoulder position arrives as a float32 revolution value and is not quantised here

shoulder_lag_s.source: no GDS68 torque-loop bandwidth or friction data in the repository; 0 = ideal torque source, scan in M5

elbow_lag_s.source: bare M3508 mechanical time constant, hardware reference 6.2 (official test condition, not this load)

rate_hz.source: HX711 module fixed at 10 SPS, user decision 2026-10-22 (RATE left unchanged)

delay_ms.source: one 10 SPS sample period; conversion and transfer time not measured, plan 1.2 allows 100-200 ms

enabled.source: the force path only matters when the DLL build enables S5_R5_FORCE_ASSIST; otherwise the site reports confirmed=false and the trigger stays off
